channel.title: Wire — DevOps
channel.description: DevOps from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: More Incidents Don't Necessarily Mean Less Reliability
item.description: One of the most common assumptions in engineering leadership is that a rising number of reported incidents signals declining system reliability. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Packer v1.16.0 brings verifiable provenance to machine images
item.description: Packer v1.16.0 adds native SLSA provenance generation and verification for machine images, along with new HCL2 features for provisioners and variables. (1 source: hashicorp)

item.title: Rx.NET 7.0 Reduces Deployment Size by Splitting Windows UI Support
item.description: Rx.NET 7.0 has been released with a narrowly focused change aimed at reducing deployment size for Windows applications. (1 source: infoq)
